messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — GPU memory pressure detected in hotpool-eu-west. Multiple OOMKilled containers during prefill. Paging eng-oncall @amy (rotation). https://redwood.ops/incidents/8007654321

amy (oncall): On it, joining. grabbing logs and pod statuses.

ben (eng-runtime): Any signs of customer impact yet? which routes are spiking?

jess (customer-success): Customer X reported repeated 502s and dropped streams ~ 08:10UTC. They're seeing reconnect loops.

ops-bot: kube-event: Pod hotpool-eu-west-42 restarted (Reason=OOMKilled) at 2026-03-17T08:09:44Z

charlie (ml): Looking at runtime logs — a bunch of very long prefill sessions. Kernel shows cuda illegal address on one restart but mem usage was saturated during prefill. snippet:

```
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-SXM4-40G     Off       | 00000000:18:00.0 | N/A                |
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  GPU   PID   Type   Process name                             GPU Memory Usage |
|    0  24567 C+G   python                                     39235MiB / 40960MiB |
```

charlie (ml): prompt lengths hitting ~1.2M tokens in a few sessions — prefill is allocating KV cache + full context, blowing VRAM.

amy (oncall): Proposed mitigations:
1) Apply immediate route-level throttle to long-context generation routes.
2) Disable prefetch/prefill for hotpool nodes.
3) Force fallback to smaller quantized variant for affected tenants.
4) Cordone/drain the node and rotate the hotpool.

ben (eng-runtime): I can apply throttles. Which precise endpoints?

amy (oncall): route tag `model:long-context` and path `/v1/generate` with header `x-context=long`. Start with 1 req/s per tenant.

ben (eng-runtime): running controlplane command now:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/route/throttle \
  -d '{"selector":"model:long-context","rate":1,"scope":"tenant"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'
```

ops-bot: Throttle applied: model:long-context rate=1r/s scope=tenant — acknowledged.

amy (oncall): Also enabling cold-fallback for the top 2 impacted tenants (customer-x, customer-y) — switch model_variant -> small-8bit. Jess, please confirm comms.

jess (customer-success): Notifying both customers and posting to status page now: "Partial outage in EU-west: GPU memory pressure causing restarts; mitigations in progress."

ben (eng-runtime): Pod still OOMing, restarted 3x in last 2 minutes. Recommending cordon + drain eu-west node hosting hotpool-42.

ops-bot: Command issued: `kubectl cordon node/eu-west-3 && kubectl drain node/eu-west-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

amy (oncall): Customer impact estimate: ~3% of EU requests failing; affected tenants are throttled and on fallback. ETA for stable state ~30 minutes after node rotation. Putting SLO risk at moderate.

charlie (ml): Pushed hotfix to runtime to trim KV cache during prefill: PR #3421 merged (rollback safe). Also adding dynamic max_sequence cap at 1_000_000 tokens to prevent runaway prefills.

ben (eng-runtime): Autoscaler spin-up in progress to replace cordoned capacity. Increasing hotpool size by +2 nodes temporarily.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: launched 2 instances for hotpool-eu-west (instance ids i-0a1b2c3d, i-0d3c2b1a).

ben (eng-runtime): Memory usage stabilizing on the remaining pods, no OOM restarts in the last 5m. KV-trimming showing lower VRAM pressure.

amy (oncall): Summary of live mitigation: throttled long-context routes, disabled prefetch on hot nodes, forced small-8bit fallback for 2 tenants, trimmed KV cache, cordoned/drained bad node, increased hotpool by +2.

jess (customer-success): Status update posted and customers notified. CS will follow up with customer-x for RCA once stable.

charlie (ml): Post-incident actions: add per-tenant seq-length caps, telemetry for prefill peak allocation, and auto-fallback policy when prefill > 80% VRAM. Filing ticket infra#5123.

ben (eng-runtime): Monitoring shows throughput back to normal for majority traffic. I'll stay on for rotation handoff.

amy (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff: @ben will continue watch; I'll update incident channel and mark oncall handoff in 15m. Closing pager for now — will reopen if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
